title: Seawater Sample Preparation for Microplastic Determination
author: Mª olores Gelado Caballero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcfyitpw

steps.title: Clean Sample Beaker
steps.instruction: Rinse the glass beaker used for seawater sample transfer thoroughly three times with MilliQ water and record the sample volume.

steps.title: Filter Seawater Sample
steps.instruction: Filter the full volume of the seawater sample using a vacuum filtration system equipped with a glass microfibre filter (0.7 μm; GF/F ø=47 mm).

steps.title: Rinse Filtration System
steps.instruction: Rinse the vacuum filtration system three times during the filtration process to ensure no particles remain.

steps.title: Dry the Filter
steps.instruction: Transfer the filter to a petri dish and dry it overnight in an oven at 60 °C.

steps.title: Analyze Particles
steps.instruction: Observe the filter under a microscope to identify particles, taking pictures and measurements according to Lusher et al (2014) guidelines.
